provision.quote: Challenge is to show cause notice dated 28/09/2025 issued by respondent no.3, under Section 74 of The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

financial_years.quote: The notice dated 28/09/2025 pertains to financial years 2018-19 to 2022-23 saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

document_contents.quote: The notice dated 28/09/2025 pertains to financial years 2018-19 to 2022-23 saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

defects_argued.quote: In the light of the statutory scheme, we find that there is no scope for consolidating various financial years/tax period which is attempted by the impugned Show Cause Notices assailed in the Petition.

outcome.quote: With the above liberty, and for the reasons set out in Milroc Good Earth Developers (supra) and Rite Water Solutions (India) Ltd. (supra), the petition is partly allowed.
